notes:
v2.7.3 makes backups automatic and more reliable. Please update.

Automatic backups, on by default: while Dogbox is open, it now backs up your company file every hour and keeps the last 10, in a Dogbox Backups folder in your Documents folder. Before, auto-backup stayed off until you chose a folder, so many people had no backups at all. If you had already turned it off or chosen your own settings, they're kept. To keep a copy off your computer as well, choose a folder that's synced to the cloud (OneDrive, Dropbox or Google Drive) or on a USB drive under Settings > Auto-Backup.

Backups now include your latest work: a backup taken while Dogbox was in use could miss the most recent changes, because they were still in a separate working file next to the company file. Backups, Back Up Now and Download now use the database's own backup method, which always makes a complete copy. If you rely on backups made before this update, make a fresh one with Back Up Now.

Safer restore: Restore Backup now checks that the file you chose is a sound company file before changing anything, and saves your current file in the backup folder first (named ..._before_restore_...), so you can go back to it if you picked the wrong backup.

The Backup guide under Help has been rewritten for the current Settings screen.
